items.text: Kotema EJAKAIT Musa kamodiŋ naka Sinai, kotoma owema loka airiamunun, kapaaran nasodit naka elap lokiareit, kokaru lokiareit akaulo kanyounikec kakwap nako Misiri, ebe,
“Kimarata yesi ekodet kere loka idwe luka Isirael, kwape ejaatar ikekiakec, kwape ejaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakec, kwape ejaar etiai loka ikiroriakec, ŋolikiliokit, kwape ejaatar akecekwes;
Ageun kaluka ikar akaisaarei ka luedeparito, kere luepedorete alosit ojie koIsirael, imarete ijo ka Aaron kes kwape ejaatar irioŋetakec,
Ejauni etuŋanan loka ŋiniteker nepepe kayes; ŋolidiopet loepolokinit ekal loka lukapapaake,
Lu kes ikiroria luka ituŋa luebwoenenete nepepe kayes: loka Reuben: Elisur okoku loka Sedeur.
Loka Simeon; Selumiel okoku loka Surisadai,
Loka Yuda; Nason okoku loka Aminadab,
Loka Isakar; Netanel okoku loka Suar,
Loka Sebulun; Eliab okoku loka Kelon.
Loka idwe luka Yosep: loka Epuraim; Elisama okoku loka Amikud; loka Manase; Gamaliel okoku loka Peda-sur.
Loka Benyamin; Abidan okoku loka Gideoni.
Loka Dan; Akleser okoku loka Amisadai,
Loka Aser; Pagiel okoku loka Ocuran.
Loka Gad; Eliasap okoku loka Deuel.
Loka Naputali; Akira okoku loka Enan.”
Ŋul kes luaponi konyaraunai kotoma okodet, ikapolok luka atekerin nuka lukapapaakee; kes luapolokinito ikekia luka Isirael.
Koyanaasi Musa ka Aaron ituŋa nul luebilitai ikeeekiroria:.

Kotukonokis ekodet kere nepepe kapaaran nasodit naka elap lokiareit, koJimosi lukapapaakec, kwape ejaatar ikekiakee, kwape ejaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakee, kwape ejaar etiai loka ikiroriakee, ageun kaluka ikar akaisaarei ka luedeparito, kwape ejaatar akwesikee.
Kwape abu EJAKAIT kieorakinitor Musa, kimar kes kwaŋin kamodiŋ naka Sinai,

Idwe luka Reuben, ekiyai loka Isirael, aturiokee, kwape ejaatar ikekiakee, kwape ejaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakee, kwape ejaar etiai loka ikiroriakee, kwape ejaatar akwesikee, ŋolikiliokit ageun kaluka ikar akaisaarei ka luedeparito, kere luepedorete alosit ojie;
Ŋul luaponi kimarai kakesi, luka ateker naka Reuben, emwaasi ilukumin akaisaoŋon ka lukanykape ka akwat akany (46,500).

Idwe luka Simeon, aturiokee, kwape ejaatar ikekiakee, kwape ejaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakee, nul luaponi kimarai kakesi, kwape ejaar etiai loka ikiroriakee, kwape ejaatar akwesikec, nolikiliokit ageun kaluka ikar akaisaarei ka luedeparito, kere luepedorete alosit ojie;
Ŋul luaponi kimarai kakesi, luka ateker naka Simeon, emwaasi ilukumin akaisakany ka lukanykaonon ka akwat auni (59,300),

Idwe luka Gad, aturiokee, kwape ejaatar ikekiakee, kwape ejaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakee, kwape ejaar etiai loka ikiroriakee, ageun kaluka ikar akaisaarei ka luedeparito, kere luepedorete alosit ojie:
Ŋul luaponi kimarai kakesi, luka ateker naka Gad, emwaasi ilukumin akaisaoijon ka lukany ka akwat akanykape ka akaisakany (45,650).

Idwe luka Yuda, aturiokee, kwape ejaatar ikekiakee, kwape ejaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakee, kwape ejaar etiai loka ikiroriakee, ageun kaluka ikar akaisaarei ka luedeparito, kere luepedorete alosit oiie;
Ŋul luaponi kimarai kakesi, luka ateker naka Yuda, emwaasi ilukumin akaisakanykaarei ka luonon ka akwat akanykape (74,600).

Idwe luka Isakar, aturiokee, kwape ejaatar ikekiakee, kwape ejaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakec, kwape eiaar etiai loka ikiroriakee, ageun kaluka ikar akaisaarei ka luedeparito, kere luepedorete alosit ojie;
Ŋul luaponi kimarai kakesi, luka ateker naka Isakar, emwaasi ilukumin akaisakany ka luoŋon ka akwat aoŋon (54,400).

Idwe luka Sebulun, aturiokee, kwape ejaatar ikekiakee, kwape ejaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakee, kwape ejaar etiai loka ikiroriakec, ageun kaluka ikar akaisaarei ka luedeparito, kere luepedorete alosit ojie;
Ŋul luaponi kimarai kakesi, luka ateker naka Sebulun, emwaasi ilukumin akaisakany ka lukanykaarei ka akwat aoŋon (57,400).

Idwe luka Yosep, kes lu, luka idwe luka Epuraim, aturiokee, kwape ejaatar ikekiakec, kwape ejaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakee, kwape eiaar etiai loka ikiroriakee, ageun kaluka ikar akaisaarei ka luedeparito, kere luepedorete alosit ojie;
Ŋul luaponi kimarai kakesi, luka ateker naka Epuraim, emwaasi ilukumin akaisaoŋon ka akwat akany (40,500).

Idwe luka Manase, aturiokee, kwape ejaatar ikekiakee, kwape ejaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakee, kwape ejaar etiai loka ikiroriakee, ageun kaluka ikar akaisaarei ka luedeparito, kere luepedorete alosit ojie:
Ŋulluaponi kimarai kakesi, luka ateker naka Manase, emwaasi ilukumin akaisauni ka luarei ka akwat aarei (32,200).

Idwe luka Benyamin, aturiokee, kwape ejaatar ikekiakee, kwape ejaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakee, kwape ejaar etiai loka ikiroriakee, ageun kaluka ikar akaisaarei ka luedeparito, kere luepedorete alosit ojie:
Ŋul luaponi kimarai kakesi, luka ateker naka Benyamin, emwaasi ilukumin akaisauni ka lukany ka akwat aoŋon (35,400),

Idwe luka Dan, aturiokec, kwape ejaatar ikekiakec, kwape ejaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakec, kwape eiaar etiai loka ikiroriakee, ageun kaluka ikar akaisaarei ka luedeparito, kere luepedorete alosit ojie;
Ŋul luaponi kimarai kakesi, luka ateker naka Dan, emwaasi ilukumin akaisakanykape ka luarei ka akwat akanykaarei (62,700).

Idwe luka Aser, aturiokee, kwape ejaatar ikekiakee, kwape ejaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakee, kwape ejaar etiai loka ikiroriakee, ageun kaluka ikar akaisaarei ka luedeparito, kere luepedorete alosit ojie;
Ŋul luaponi kimarai kakesi, luka ateker naka Aser, emwaasi ilukumin akaisaoŋon ka lodiopet ka akwat akany (41,500).

Idwe luka Naputali, aturiokee, kwape ejaatar ikekiakee, kwape ejaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakee, kwape ejaar etiai loka ikiroriakee, ageun kaluka ikar akaisaarei ka luedeparito, kere luepedorete alosit oiic:
Ŋul luaponi kimarai kakesi, luka ateker naka Naputali, emwaasi ilukumin akaisakany ka luuni ka akwat aoŋon (53,400).
Ŋul kes luaponi kimarai, luemarete Musa ka Aaron, ka ikapolok luka Isirael, emwaasi ituŋa itomon ka luarei: ninitunanan kakesi ajai kanuka ekal loka lukapapaake.
Aso kere luaponi kimarai kodwe luka Isirael kwape ejaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakee, ageun kaluka ikar akaisaarei ka luedeparito, kere luepedorete alosit ojie koIsirael:
Kes kere luaponi kimarai emwaasi ilukumin akwat akanykape kaluuni ka akwat akany ka akaisakany (603,550).
Konye Ilebin kwape eiaar ateker naka lukapapaakee mam aponi kimarakinai tomakec,
Naarai abu Edeke kolimok Musa ebe,
Ateker bon naka Lebi ŋes mam jo imari, karaida aimorikikin etiaikec toma otiai loka idwe luka Isirael:

Konye kodakak ijo Ilebin aidar ewema lokalaunan loka aitejenunet, ka iboro kere lukotoma, ka iboro kere lueiaatar; edakete kesi ewema lokalaunan, ka iboroke kere; ijaanakinete ŋes, ido idukurete kesi airimor ewema lokalaunan.
Naitobwosere ewema lokalaunan, Ilebin kes eusete iloin ka anunuk da; ido naibubukinere ewema, Ilebin kes ibubukinete: ido eario eloŋwait kere loikunyuni die kewema.
Ibubuete idwe luka Isirael iwemanakee, ninitunanan owai loitebeitai aketeker, ninitunanan owai loka emederake, kwape ejaatar irionetakec.
Konye idukurete Ilebin airimor ewema lokalaunan loka aitejenunet, kinyek anyunyura abunokin ekodet loka idwe luka Isirael: ido idarete Ilebin ewema lokalaunan loka aiteienunet.”
Kiswamata idwe luka Isirael kwaŋin; kere kwape kieorakinia EJAKAIT Musa, kiswamata kwaŋin.
